title: John W. Engeman Theater

services.name: Season Tickets
services.desc: Introduce the young ones in your life to the magic of live theater-and enjoy quality family time together! Build an experience that fits your needs, schedule, and preferences, while enjoying exclusive benefits and savings over single-ticket prices. A Children’s Flex Season Ticket Package includes one ticket to each of our children’s shows-you choose the dates that work best for you. It makes a great gift, too! Purchase your package online or by contacting our Box Office

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Experience the charm of Northport Village at the historic John W. Engeman Theater, perfectly suited for corporate events. Host your award ceremony, product demonstration, or TED-style talk in our theater, or entertain your clients and staff in our Lobby Lounge with an elegant private cocktail party. Our venue offers easy access via public transportation and is strategically located near major business hubs such as Melville and Hauppauge. Facilities: Stage, professional lighting, green room, catering options, A/V packages, lobby lounge bar Services: Event staff, partner restaurant, and accommodations at The Northport Hotel Each event is tailored to meet your unique needs.
